=== unknown 68
/frobnicate  isn't a command rush knows

  rush has no view of its own for it, and this session didn't list
  it among its commands, so it's most likely one of Claude Code's
  own screens.

▍ Open it in Claude Code                                            
    in this agent's folder and account · esc, then ctrl+c twice, …
  Send it to Claude as a message
    as you typed it

↑↓ choose  ·  enter go  ·  esc cancel
=== claude 68
claude:teleport  send a session to the cloud, or bring one back fro…

  ↗ This opens a real Claude Code                                   

  /teleport is Claude Code's own, for your account or Claude's
  cloud, and rush leaves it to Claude Code. rush hands the
  terminal to a fresh Claude Code in this agent's folder, on its
  account, and opens /teleport abc there. It isn't this
  conversation.

  When you're done: esc, then ctrl+c twice, and you're back here.

enter open Claude Code  ·  esc cancel
